description: This is a PHP test class for the SkillService component within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It contains unit tests for skill CRUD operations and search functionalities, utilizing mock objects and test data fixtures.

classes.name: SkillServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the SkillService functionalities such as delete, get by id, save, and search skills within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including creating a SkillService instance and loading test data fixtures.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests the deletion of skills via SkillService with a mock SkillDao, verifying that deleteSkills returns the expected number of deleted records.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a skill by ID, using test fixture data and a mock SkillDao.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a Skill object through SkillService with a mock SkillDao, ensuring the saved skill matches the input.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills with given filter parameters, validating that returned objects are instances of Skill and count matches expectations.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting skills matching search criteria, verifying the count returned by SkillService matches expected value.
